page_title: MON 1-0 SAS | Monza v Sassuolo 28/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+7' Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90+5' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot inches over the bar.
90+3' Alessio Zerbin (Monza) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
90+1' Substitution. Emil Konradsen Ceide (Sassuolo) in, Josh Doig out.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Raffaele Palladino has decided to make a change. Davide Bettella (Monza) replaces Matteo Pessina.
87' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Luca Caldirola as he is replaced by Armando Izzo (Monza).
84' Total attempts – 11:10.
82' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
82' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Now Sassuolo have a corner.
81' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
79' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) jumps into a tackle and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Luca Lipani (Sassuolo) is coming onto the pitch as Daniel Boloca cannot continue after picking up an injury.
77' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Andrea Colpani will be replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Monza).
77' A snap shot from distance by Matteo Pessina (Monza) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
75' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Kristian Thorstvedt walks off the pitch to be replaced by Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo).
72' Warren Bondo (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
68' Yellow card. Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
64' 1:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
60' The resulting corner from Andrea Colpani (Monza) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

60' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Monza force a corner. They send men into the box.
58' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
57' Milan Djuric (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentin Carboni.
55' Sassuolo seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
54' The corner is swung in but Sassuolo can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

53' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' The foul by Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) was seen by Gianluca Manganiello who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
52' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
49' Valentin Carboni (Monza) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
46' Half-time substitution. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is replaced by Mattia Viti.
46' The game is over for Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza). Warren Bondo comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Alessio Dionisi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo). He is replaced by Samuele Mulattieri.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The resulting corner from Andrea Colpani (Monza) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) was quite harsh and Gianluca Manganiello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
43' Michele Di Gregorio reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) low towards the middle of the goal.
42' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
41' Andrea Colpani (Monza) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Valentin Carboni (Monza). The linesman points to the corner flag, Monza are going to take it.
38' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

34' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Monza are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
31' 1 - 0 Goal! Dany Mota shows great vision to find Andrea Colpani (Monza) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 1:0.

30' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
29' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
28' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
27' Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
26' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Michele Di Gregorio easily deals with the threat.
24' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Monza due to an offside in the build-up play.
24' Wait! Referee Gianluca Manganiello has indicated he is going to review the Monza goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
22' Goal! Samuele Birindelli plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Dany Mota (Monza), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header low into the middle of the goal from close range. 1:0.

20' Monza slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
17' Samu Castillejo (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
16' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes a short corner kick.
16' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sassuolo.

15' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
10' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
9' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
8' A lofted cross from Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
7' An accurate cross picks out Valentin Carboni (Monza) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
5' Andrea Colpani (Monza) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

4' Dany Mota (Monza) and Andrea Colpani try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monza.
3' A sweet pass inside the box gives Dany Mota (Monza) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Sassuolo will kick the game off.
Gianluca Manganiello is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
